benchmark_type_evidence: We introduce IrokoBench—a human-translated benchmark dataset for 17 typologically-diverse low-resource African languages covering three tasks: natural language inference (AfriXNLI), mathematical reasoning (AfriMGSM), and multi-choice knowledge-based question answering (AfriMMLU).
brief_description: IrokoBench is a human-translated benchmark for 17 typologically-diverse low-resource African languages, comprising three tasks: natural language inference (AfriXNLI, from XNLI), multi-choice knowledge QA (AfriMMLU, from MMLU), and mathematical reasoning (AfriMGSM, from MGSM). It evaluates LLMs on complex reasoning and knowledge-intensive tasks for African languages.
